issues_log.handling: No header and no match in the uploaded file; cannot be completed from the file alone
issues_log.action: NOT fabricated. Please supply the source for these seasons

issues_log.description: War-time matches flagged "not included in official statistics" (sheet 1950)
Chelsea v Manchester City 2024-25: date/time taken from the user message
Bracketed half-time scores in match headers
Cells like "Report", "Table", "Teams Table" in extra columns
Listed scorers differ from score (own goals, old records)
Goals scored but no scorer lines
Sheet names are not season ranges (e.g. sheet 2024 holds 2021-22 to 2024-25)
Debut Players, Final Appearances, Match Facts averages (age) are outside the requested layout

schema.description: Unique key = season start year + running number inside the season
Season label
Official, or Unofficial (war-time matches the source says are excluded from official statistics)
Cumulative official match number from the source "Match Facts" line; used to detect missing matches
Match date (yyyy-mm-dd)
Kick-off time
Competition; trailing league "Position N" removed per instruction
Stadium
Attendance as a number
Referee
Main team, always Chelsea
Chelsea goals in the full-time score; half-time bracket scores are NOT kept
Literal "ft" separator, as in the requested layout
Opponent goals in the full-time score
Opposing team
Home/Away = Chelsea listed first/second in the source header (neutral venues are not distinguished)
W/D/L from Chelsea view: =IF(L>N,"W",IF(L<N,"L","D"))
Chelsea manager
Opponent manager
Original source order of the teams
Number of starters parsed; completeness indicator (expected 11)
OK = listed scorers equal the score; MISMATCH; NO_SCORER_DATA (indicative only: own goals/old records)
Shoot-out text if the source has one
Source remarks (comments, extra time, abandoned etc.)
Processing flags, e.g. DATE_FROM_USER_MESSAGE, CHELSEA_STARTERS_NE_11
Location of the match header in the uploaded workbook (traceability)
Link to Matches; one row per player per team
Starter / Sub Used / Sub Not Used
Order of appearance in the source line-up
Shirt number when the source lists it (older games and opponents often have none)
Player name as in the source
For Sub Used: who was replaced and when (raw text and numeric minute)
Link to Matches
Goal / Penalty Goal / Own Goal / Yellow Card / Red Card / Penalty Missed / Substitution
Minute as written, and numeric minute (stoppage "90+2" -> 90)
Player concerned. For Substitution this is the player going OUT
Substitution only: player coming IN
Qualifier from the source such as Pen or Saved
Original text before matching to the line-up
One row per season 1905-1906 to 2024-2025; counts are live formulas on Matches
Every data problem found, count and action taken
Missing text/date/number is written as "-" (requested for Date, applied to all)
